derived_scaling.note: Slopes use production GPU median minus CARD_CONTROL GPU median. They isolate tier-dependent shaded-fragment/light work better than total viewport time, but remain empirical end-to-end measurements rather than shader instruction counts.

methodology.alu_probe: Fixed synthetic 96-iteration arithmetic chain after common card prep; device sensitivity calibration only.
methodology.card_control: Common hair-card preparation with trivial unshaded output.
methodology.lut_probe: Fixed 16 dependent trilinear Texture3D samples after common card prep; device sensitivity calibration only.
methodology.repeats: Separate Godot processes; tier order rotates/reverses by repeat index.
methodology.runtime: RenderingServer viewport GPU/CPU render-time measurements with per-variant prewarm, settle, and sample windows.
methodology.source_inventory: Expanded-source structural counts; never post-compile ISA counts.
